title: Access card input
description: Mirrors AccessCardDocumentProps (the manage-student-access issue response plus the first class and the claim URL).

className.description: The student's first class; omitted when none.

siblings.description: Other students covered by this login.

code.description: The one-time code, printed as given.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601; printed en-US as e.g. Nov 20, 2026, 10:30 AM in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh.

claimUrl.description: Where the family enters the code (origin + /claim).
